warnings.message: Non-localhost preview/production origins are not confirmed in the Campaigns App SDK origin allowlist. SDK runtime checks may be blocked after deploy.

CampaignSpec campaign.store_url "https://store.example.com" looks like a local/placeholder store, not a live storefront. Localhost is valid as a Development-domain QA origin, but a real shopper cannot transact against it. Set the merchant's production store_url before launch.

Starter-template checkout pages enable paypal, klarna, apple_pay, google_pay in the payment-methods include by default, but the CampaignSpec does not list them in available_payment_methods/available_express_payment_methods. If you build on a starter template family, remove the show_* arg(s) from the checkout payment-methods include (or add the method to the spec) so unsupported methods do not ship.
